description: This source file defines the 'Create' feature for user account creation in a .NET application. It includes the 'UserData' record, command validation, and the handler for processing user creation requests, including validation, password hashing, database persistence, and JWT token generation.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: A record that holds user input data: Username, Email, and Password.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: A request command containing user data, implementing IRequest for processing.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command ensuring Username, Email, and Password are provided and not empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user creation process: validation, checking for existing users, password hashing, database insertion, and JWT token issuance.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Performs the user creation logic asynchronously, including validation, uniqueness checks, password hashing, database persistence, and token generation.
